fieldValues.title: A decision settled on principle in an issue comment does not reach the builder, so the same issue stops again
fieldValues.summary: The builder reads an issue's body (its Ruling line, guard and plan) and its labels, not the comment thread. On 2026-10-27 srs#236 was decided on principle in a comment, but its body still said 'Decision required', it kept needs-input and its parent was outside the roadmap; builders stopped on it on 10-29, 10-30 and 10-30 again, and one raised a duplicate proposed decision (21b6b4b7) for a question already settled. The same day's sweep (finding e832c6f4) named srs-rust#1198, #683, #1339, #1132 and #1380 as not questions, yet all five kept needs-input for three more days until their bodies and labels were changed on 2026-10-30.
fieldValues.body: Settling is not done until the record the next agent reads carries it: the Ruling line, the plan and the labels. A comment is testimony that no routine consults. A remedy would make 'settled' mean an edit to the body and labels, checked by clerk flow (a hold whose question has a settling comment).
